How this was counted

  1. 01 Read {{AUDITS}} local audit files and {{ROLLOUTS}} rollouts, including available archived sessions.
  2. 02 Deduplicate by optimizer attempt ID. {{SNAPSHOTS}} repeated state snapshots do not inflate the total.
  3. 03 Prefer complete audit records; use rollout records to fill gaps. {{MALFORMED}} malformed records were skipped.

Scope: available Smart Prune records in the local Elpis and Codex homes, including recorded experiments. Deleted records and histories held elsewhere may be absent. This is not a billing statement or a quality evaluation.
